reading_note: The teaching traces a single arc: how natural life (flesh) arises in three discrete modes — from ordered conjunction, from disordered/aborted states, and from self-derived spontaneous generation — and shows that each mode corresponds to a placement of "enthumesis" (intellectual desire/the conceiving faculty) at a different degree (root, branch, seed). This botanical/biological taxonomy is then transposed to the human spiritual condition: the difference between the "virgin" (pure light untouched by the war with evil, the icon of the elect descending) and the "continent" (light that was commingled with darkness, purified itself, and rose — the New Man chosen out of the Old). The arc moves from generation in lowest nature → through the molding work of enthumesis in vegetation → to the regenerative process in the human, where falsity-from-evil (dragon) is overcome and what was mixed becomes holy.
